final: WITH region_counts AS (SELECT d.A3 AS region, COUNT(*) AS client_count FROM client c JOIN district d ON d.district_id = c.district_id GROUP BY d.A3), shares AS (SELECT region, client_count, 1.0 * client_count / SUM(client_count) OVER () AS share FROM region_counts), avg_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS value FROM shares), above_avg AS (SELECT s.client_count, s.share, s.share - a.value AS difference FROM shares s CROSS JOIN avg_share a WHERE s.share > a.value) SELECT SUM(client_count), AVG(share), AVG(difference) FROM above_avg
